answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy can be achieved via a Proof-of-Uniqueness mechanism. Each agent must generate a cryptographically-bound, non-fungible identifier derived from a scarce resource, creating a unique 'garden' of attestations. This process demands a high computational cost, as if each identity required forging a unique crystal from raw energy. An attacker needs to conquer each independent 'knoll' of identity generation, making it economically infeasible to create a multitude of fake personas due to the per-identity resource expenditure.
